```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false 
#| warning: false
library(bib2df)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(glue)

# Path is relative to this .qmd file
pubs <- bib2df("publications/publications.bib") |>
  arrange(desc(YEAR))

# Matches "Palomo-Munoz", "Palomo‐Munoz" (odd hyphen) and "Palomo"
my_name <- "Palomo"

get_doi <- function(row) {
  doi <- row$DOI
  if (is.na(doi) && !is.na(row$URL)) {
    doi <- str_extract(row$URL, "10\\.\\d{4,9}/\\S+")
  }
  str_remove(doi, "^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/")
}

fmt_entry <- function(row) {
  authors <- row$AUTHOR[[1]]
  is_me   <- str_detect(authors, regex(my_name, ignore_case = TRUE))
  authors <- if_else(is_me, paste0("**", authors, "**"), authors)
  authors <- paste(authors, collapse = ", ")

  title <- str_remove_all(row$TITLE, "[{}]")

  venue <- coalesce(row$JOURNAL, row$BOOKTITLE, "")
  venue <- if (nzchar(venue)) glue(" *{venue}*.") else ""

  doi  <- get_doi(row)
  link <- if (!is.na(doi)) {
    glue(" <https://doi.org/{doi}>")
  } else if (!is.na(row$URL)) {
    glue(" <{row$URL}>")
  } else ""

  glue("{authors} ({row$YEAR}). {title}.{venue}{link}")
}

fmt_badge <- function(row) {
  if (is.na(row$DOI)) return("")
  d <- str_remove(row$DOI, "^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/")
  glue('<div class="altmetric-embed" data-badge-type="donut" data-doi="{d}" data-hide-no-mentions="true"></div>')
}

for (y in unique(pubs$YEAR)) {
  cat("\n\n## ", y, "\n\n", sep = "")
  yr <- filter(pubs, YEAR == y)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(yr))) {
    cat(
      "\n::::: {.grid}\n\n",
      "::: {.g-col-11}\n", fmt_entry(yr[i, ]), "\n:::\n\n",
      "::: {.g-col-1}\n", fmt_badge(yr[i, ]), "\n:::\n\n",
      ":::::\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
}

```
